From a2e8bbd2ef5457485f00b6b947bbbfa2778e5b1e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Martin KaFai Lau <kafai@fb.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jun 2017 22:30:17 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] bpf: Fix test_obj_id.c for llvm 5.0

llvm 5.0 does not like the section name and the function name
to be the same:

clang -I. -I./include/uapi -I../../../include/uapi \
	-I../../../../samples/bpf/ \
	-Wno-compare-distinct-pointer-types \
	-O2 -target bpf -c \
	linux/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c -o \
	linux/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.o
fatal error: error in backend: 'test_prog_id' label emitted multiple times to
assembly file
clang-5.0: error: clang frontend command failed with exit code 70 (use -v to
see invocation)
clang version 5.0.0 (trunk 304326) (llvm/trunk 304329)

This patch makes changes to the section name and the function name.

Fixes: 95b9afd3987f ("bpf: Test for bpf ID")
Reported-by: Alexei Starovoitov <ast@fb.com>
Reported-by: Yonghong Song <yhs@fb.com>
Signed-off-by: Martin KaFai Lau <kafai@fb.com>
Acked-by: Daniel Borkmann <daniel@iogearbox.net>
Acked-by: Yonghong Song <yhs@fb.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c b/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c
index d8723aaf827a..880d2963b472 100644
--- a/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c
+++ b/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c
@@ -23,8 +23,8 @@ struct bpf_map_def SEC("maps") test_map_id = {
 	.max_entries = 1,
 };
 
-SEC("test_prog_id")
-int test_prog_id(struct __sk_buff *skb)
+SEC("test_obj_id_dummy")
+int test_obj_id(struct __sk_buff *skb)
 {
 	__u32 key = 0;
 	__u64 *value;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c`**
   - The section name was changed from `SEC("test_prog_id")` to `SEC("test_obj_id_dummy")`.
   - The function name was changed from `int test_prog_id(struct __sk_buff *skb)` to `int test_obj_id(struct __sk_buff *skb)`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the file are directly related to resolving a conflict that arises when the section name and the function name are the same, which is not supported in LLVM 5.0. By changing both the section name and the function name, the patch ensures that the code compiles successfully without errors related to label emissions in the assembly file. This change addresses the bug reported by users and aligns the code with the requirements of the newer LLVM version.

Here is the commit message:
bpf: Fix test_obj_id.c for llvm 5.0

llvm 5.0 does not like the section name and the function name
to be the same:

clang -I. -I./include/uapi -I../../../include/uapi \
	-I../../../../samples/bpf/ \
	-Wno-compare-distinct-pointer-types \
	-O2 -target bpf -c \
	linux/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c -o \
	linux/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.o
fatal error: error in backend: 'test_prog_id' label emitted multiple times to
assembly file
clang-5.0: error: clang frontend command failed with exit code 70 (use -v to
see invocation)
clang version 5.0.0 (trunk 304326) (llvm/trunk 304329)

This patch makes changes to the section name and the function name.

Fixes: 95b9afd3987f ("bpf: Test for bpf ID")
Reported-by: Alexei Starovoitov <ast@fb.com>
Reported-by: Yonghong Song <yhs@fb.com>
Signed-off-by: Martin KaFai Lau <kafai@fb.com>
Acked-by: Daniel Borkmann <daniel@iogearbox.net>
Acked-by: Yonghong Song <yhs@fb.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

Here is the root cause:
The bug is caused by the LLVM 5.0 compiler not allowing the section name and the function name to be identical, which leads to multiple label emissions for the same name in the assembly file, resulting in a compilation error.

Here is the patch:
-SEC("test_prog_id")
-int test_prog_id(struct __sk_buff *skb)
+SEC("test_obj_id_dummy")
+int test_obj_id(struct __sk_buff *skb)
 {
 	__u32 key = 0;
 	__u64 *value;
 
 	value = bpf_map_lookup_elem(&test_map_id, &key);
 
 	return TC_ACT_OK;
 }
--

Reason:
The LLVM 5.0 compiler does not permit the section name (`test_prog_id`) and the function name (`test_prog_id`) to be the same, which causes multiple label emissions for the same name in the assembly file, leading to a compilation error.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
SEC("test_obj_id_dummy")
int test_obj_id(struct __sk_buff *skb)
```
Reason:
By changing the section name to `test_obj_id_dummy` and the function name to `test_obj_id`, the patch ensures that the section name and function name are distinct, thus preventing the multiple label emission issue and allowing the code to compile successfully.
